implemented.retention: Original retained entries own canonical ID/signature text through scratch cleanup. Cache hits release duplicate temporary keys and reinsert the actual original retained ID owner. Changed keys release the prior entry; original oversized policy releases temporary key/control ownership. Original native painting, batching/overlap/order and 128MiB RGBA byte cache policy remain unchanged.
implemented.cleanup: Failed painting preserves original null errors while all temporary keys/control owners release. Original drawing failures preserve completed retained entries for subsequent reuse. Final teardown visits every entry even after first native release failure, preserves the first error including null, drops entry/parts references and releases all key/control owners. Allocator-first disposal remains idempotent.
implemented.review: Place Map admission before byte-counter mutation so a denied insertion cannot leave inflated raster accounting. All original nine damage cases and three vector-region cases remain required alongside six vector metadata regressions.
implemented.scope: Selected vector-cache IDs/signatures, Map and entry controls. Native VM/codec/driver/crypto private storage and RSS are separate.
